'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Randy Scott DS sycfa''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Randy Scott]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Randy Scott]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Tatooine Scott DS SYCFA.txt |Download]]
